intuition: The final unused postorder value is the root, and its inorder position separates the left and right subtrees.

brute_force.approach: Search each inorder slice for the root and repeatedly create traversal slices for recursive subtrees.

optimal.approach: Index inorder positions in a map and consume postorder backward, constructing right subtrees before left subtrees.

edge_cases: An empty traversal pair yields an empty tree.
Node values are unique, so each inorder split is unambiguous.
Building right before left follows reverse postorder consumption.
